title: The Real Architecture Behind Selling Design Assets with Crypto Payments
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, you might have experienced the frustration of selling ebooks, courses, or design assets without access to Stripe or PayPal. The conventional platforms that facilitate online payments are often restricted or unavailable in certain regions, forcing creators to adapt to unconventional workarounds. This post breaks down the real architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments, providing a reliable infrastructure solution for creators worldwide.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The solution presented in this post is not a workaround but a base-layer infrastructure that empowers digital creators to own and control their digital commerce stacks. This architecture is not limited to specific regions or platforms, allowing creators to sell their assets without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. By leveraging cloud infrastructure, cryptocurrency payment verification, and automated delivery, creators can maintain full data ownership and sovereignty over their digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of five key components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This combination of tools enables seamless online transactions, automation, and delivery of digital products, all while maintaining the creator's data ownership and control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase. Both approaches work reliably and cost nothing beyond the storage used.
You can sell digital assets online without relying on conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture work together to facilitate seamless online transactions, automation, and delivery of digital products. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts the digital product, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, ensuring secure and reliable transactions.
